note: Values were read out of the cited manufacturer documents on the retrieval date. Nothing here is inferred, averaged or estimated: a field the manufacturer does not publish is absent from this file rather than present with a placeholder. In particular NO candidate carries a cycle time, because no vision manufacturer publishes one — a frame rate is how fast the sensor can acquire an image, not how long an inspection takes.

candidates.category: All-in-one smart camera with on-board inspection and measurement toolset
candidates.product_scope: Smart camera — one component of an inspection station. The station also needs a lens, lighting, a mounting frame, a part fixture and a reject path, none of which are in this product.
candidates.description: All-in-one smart camera carrying the FH-series inspection functions on board. Effective pixels 2,048 x 1,536 (3.2 MP monochrome), image acquisition 55 fps (18.0 ms), supply 21.6-26.4 VDC, ambient 0 to +40 C.
caveats: The published 55 fps / 18.0 ms is image ACQUISITION time for this sensor. It is not an inspection cycle time: the number of measurement items, the algorithm and the part handling all add to it, so the station's cycle has to be established with the application.
The published 110 x 68.5 x 55.5 mm is the camera body only. An inspection station also needs a lens, lighting, a mount, a fixture and a reject path.
IP40 as supplied. IP67 only with a lighting module or waterproof hood fitted, which are ordered separately.
Current consumption is 0.60 A without lighting modules and up to 4.2 A with them, which changes what the station's supply has to provide.
The weight is the camera alone and excludes the lens, which is ordered separately.

candidates.category: 2D machine vision sensor with a programmable inspection toolset
candidates.product_scope: Vision sensor — one component of an inspection station. The lens and the optics protection hood are ordered separately, and the station also needs lighting, a fixture and a reject path.
candidates.description: 2D snapshot machine vision sensor, CMOS monochrome, 2,048 x 1,088 px (2.1 MP) at 70 Hz, global shutter, adjustable focus, C-mount. Supply 24 V DC +/- 20 %, typ. 20 W. Enclosure IP65, ambient operating temperature 0 C to +50 C.
interfaces: PROFINET (single port; dual port via the CDF600-2 connection module)
caveats: SICK publishes the 142 x 90 x 46 mm explicitly as the housing only, without lens and optics protection hood.
The published 70 Hz is the sensor's frame rate, not an inspection cycle time.
The lens is not included and is ordered separately as an accessory; so is the illumination.
The included Quality Inspection licence covers part of the toolset. Productive use of the complete toolset needs the Intelligent Inspection upgrade licence, which is a separate item.
